summary: ID of a pre-created geofence, as an alternative to inline geometry.
range: String id of an existing geofence. Each zone needs geometry OR geofence_id.
constraints: A zone must provide exactly one of geometry / geofence_id.
businessRules: geofence_id defines: Provide the ID of a pre-created geofence using the [Geofence API](https://docs.nextbillion.ai/docs/tracking/api/geofence). Please note that one of geometry or geofence_id should be provided.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: A zone with neither geometry nor geofence_id -> 400.
testingGuidance: Negative: zone with neither geometry nor geofence_id -> 400.
